components.name: Persons, places and things
components.desc: Encyclopaedias and lexica: persons, places and things – a person's page with every source side by side, and the marks on names in the text.
components.detail: people.js. Packages of kind "people" (Smith's Biography, PIR, the Suda, Smith's Geography and Antiquities) keep their persons by number, an index of all names and, per work, the passages where a person is cited.

mem: the index of names of each installed package

components.name: The chronograph
components.desc: The chronograph: reference systems at top and bottom (Julian years, Olympiads, years of the city, consuls, the sky), between them the lanes of the texts, the persons and your own statements.
components.detail: tempora.js. Each item is what one source says about a time – never one authoritative date. Data: the Liebenam fasti, the dates in the texts, Tempora – persons; the sky computed with astronomy-engine.

cpu: laying out and drawing the lanes

components.name: Camera
components.desc: How freely the map's camera may move: looking up, deep zoom, lens, roll, free flight.

components.name: Crash reports
components.desc: A flight recorder: the app's last seconds written to the device, offered as a report after an unexpected end.

components.name: astronomy-engine
components.desc: Positions of the sun, moon and planets, eclipses and seasons (Don Cross), used by Tempora and the map's sky.

components.name: Encyclopaedia and person packages
components.desc: Smith's three dictionaries, the Prosopographia Imperii Romani, the Suda, and Tempora – persons.

components.name: Chronology packages
components.desc: The consuls (Liebenam's fasti) and the dates read from the texts.
